cues.en: Hi I'm Tyler and this is Marion, a Sulcata tortoise.
cues.zh: 我是 Tyler，这是苏卡达陆龟 Marion。

cues.en: She has dry, scaly skin making her a reptile just like crocodiles, lizards, turtles and snakes.
cues.zh: 她有干燥、有鳞片的皮肤，是爬行动物，就像鳄鱼、蜥蜴、海龟和蛇一样。

cues.en: The grass snake is the UK's longest snake and having scaly skin protects it when moving across rough ground.
cues.zh: 草蛇是英国最长的蛇，鳞片皮肤能保护它爬过粗糙的地面。

cues.en: The adder has brown zigzags running along its skin.
cues.zh: 蝰蛇的皮肤上有棕色之字形花纹。

cues.en: They're also shy and hard to find.
cues.zh: 它们也很害羞，很难被发现。

cues.en: Some reptiles like snakes haven't got any legs whilst other reptiles like sand lizards have four.
cues.zh: 有些爬行动物如蛇没有腿，而有些如沙蜥有四条腿。

cues.en: The common lizard, smooth snake and slow worm can also be found living in the UK and reptiles are found living all over the world.
cues.zh: 普通蜥蜴、滑蛇和慢蠕虫也生活在英国，爬行动物遍布世界各地。

cues.en: The Komodo dragon is the heaviest lizard on earth.
cues.zh: 科莫多龙是地球上最重的蜥蜴。

cues.en: It lives on land.
cues.zh: 它生活在陆地上。

cues.en: Reptiles can also live in the water like turtles.
cues.zh: 爬行动物也能像海龟一样生活在水中。

cues.en: And sometimes both like the green anaconda.
cues.zh: 有时两者兼具，比如绿水蟒。

cues.en: Nearly all reptiles lay eggs.
cues.zh: 几乎所有爬行动物都产卵。

cues.en: They also breathe air like we do, so those who live in water must come up for air.
cues.zh: 它们也像我们一样呼吸空气，生活在水中的必须上来换气。

cues.en: As reptiles are cold-blooded they need to bask in the sun to warm themselves up and be ready for action.
cues.zh: 爬行动物是冷血动物，需要在阳光下取暖才能活动。

cues.en: And if you think reptiles look a bit like dinosaurs that's because dinosaurs were reptiles!
cues.zh: 如果你觉得爬行动物有点像恐龙，那是因为恐龙就是爬行动物！

cues.en: So because Marion is a reptile, that means that she lays eggs, has dry scaly skin, is cold blooded and breathes air.
cues.zh: 所以 Marion 是爬行动物：她产卵、有干燥鳞片皮肤、冷血并且呼吸空气。

cues.en: Oh and there she goes starting to walk off to have a sunbathe and keep warm.
cues.zh: 哦，她走开去晒太阳保暖了。

cues.en: Reptiles are found on all the continents of the world except Antarctica.
cues.zh: 除南极洲外，世界各地都有爬行动物。

cues.en: There are four main types of reptiles: lizards and snakes, crocodiles and alligators, turtles and tortoises, and tuatara, which are only found in New Zealand.
cues.zh: 爬行动物主要有四类：蜥蜴和蛇、鳄鱼和短吻鳄、海龟和陆龟，以及仅生活在新西兰的喙头蜥。

cues.en: Each reptile has its own distinct features.
cues.zh: 每种爬行动物都有自己独特的特征。

cues.en: Snakes are reptiles which do not have limbs.
cues.zh: 蛇是没有四肢的爬行动物。

cues.en: The shell of a tortoise is part of its skeleton on the outside of its body.
cues.zh: 陆龟的壳是长在体外的骨骼的一部分。

cues.en: It is called an exoskeleton.
cues.zh: 这叫做外骨骼。

cues.en: A veiled chameleon has its own distinct features.
cues.zh: 高冠变色龙也有自己独特的特征。

cues.en: Some species of lizard drop their tails to escape predators.
cues.zh: 有些蜥蜴会断尾逃跑，躲避捕食者。

cues.en: Some reptiles live on land, while others like crocodiles spend much of their time in the water.
cues.zh: 有些生活在陆地，有些如鳄鱼大部分时间在水里。

cues.en: All reptiles have lungs and need air to breathe.
cues.zh: 所有爬行动物都有肺，需要空气才能呼吸。

cues.en: Reptiles are cold-blooded, which means they cannot control their body temperature.
cues.zh: 爬行动物是冷血动物，不能自己调节体温。

cues.en: Most reptiles lay eggs, but some reptiles such as skinks give birth to live young.
cues.zh: 大多数产卵，但有些石龙子直接生下幼崽。

cues.en: Most reptiles are carnivores and eat meat.
cues.zh: 大多数爬行动物是食肉动物。

cues.en: Turtles and tortoises are mostly herbivores.
cues.zh: 海龟和陆龟大多是食草动物。
